effect.name: Speaker Cuts
effect.description: Find where the speaker changes, and give each voice a track of its own
effect.author: Wunjo

parameter.name: sp_count
How many people
parameter.comment: Leave at 0 to let it decide. Set it when you know the number and it keeps splitting one voice in two.

parameter.name: sp_min_turn
Shortest turn
parameter.comment: Anything briefer than this is treated as noise rather than a line.

parameter.name: sp_generate
Analyse
parameter.jobparam: Nothing analysed yet. This reads the track and reports who speaks when — the clip itself is not touched
